references.text: Moses reminds the tribes that the armed men must cross over Jordan ahead of their brothers to help them take possession of the land, as described in Numbers 32:21.
Joshua reminds Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh of the promise they gave Moses that their armed men would cross over Jordan ahead of their brothers.
The fulfillment of the promise: The children of Reuben, the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh crossed over Jordan in full armor ahead of the Israelites, just as Moses had told them.
Moses repeats the condition that the armed men of Gad and Reuben must cross over Jordan before the Lord to receive their inheritance in Gilead.
The Lord will drive out the enemies ahead of Israel, reflecting the promise that the Lord will drive out His enemies from before Him.
Joshua sends Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh back after they have fulfilled their promise to fight before the Lord until the enemies were driven out.
